All 13 targeted features verified end-to-end against real backend. No blocking bugs found.

Sales user sees summary-selling ($4,233.60) and summary-total ($4,233.60) only
Backend: GET /api/estimates returns can_see_cost=false to sales; POST /api/estimating/price-books returns 403 for sales (RBAC enforced server-side)

critical_code_review_comments: estimating.py services.compute_line handles markup vs margin vs fixed pricing cleanly; comments clearly explain markup!=margin. Good.
estimates.py._can_see_cost gates cost fields, cost_summary, and cost-refresh endpoints — verified UI hides matching testids for sales.
estimating.py._clear_other_defaults enforces single default price book — verified in UI.
assembly version bump on update is correct; existing estimates preserve their snapshot via stored assembly_version.

Minor (non-blocking): EstimateEditor addProduct sets selling_unit_price=cost (0% markup) when adding from catalog picker — for sales role this shows $0 selling until an owner edits it. Consider defaulting to price_from_markup with a shop-wide default markup or applying the Default price book. Not a bug in this phase since Price Book application to editor lines isn't in scope.

success_rate.backend: not directly retested (backend was already green per agent context); RBAC 403 spot-checked
